description: This file defines data structures, constants, and methods related to network routing in the 'netlink' package, including Route, NexthopInfo, Destination, Encap, and associated functions for route comparison and string representation.

classes.name: Destination
classes.description: Interface for route destination objects with methods for family, encoding, decoding, string representation, and equality.

classes.name: Encap
classes.description: Interface for encapsulation data with methods for type, encoding, decoding, string representation, and equality.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a network route with various attributes such as source, destination, gateway, protocol, and flags.

classes.name: RouteUpdate
classes.description: Structure for route change notifications, including type, flags, and the route data.

classes.name: NexthopInfo
classes.description: Details of a next-hop in a route, including link index, gateway, flags, and associated destination/encap objects.

methods.name: Route.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Route object.

methods.name: Route.Equal
methods.description: Compares two Route objects for equality.

methods.name: Route.SetFlag
methods.description: Sets a specific flag in the route's Flags field.

methods.name: Route.ClearFlag
methods.description: Clears a specific flag in the route's Flags field.

methods.name: NexthopInfo.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NexthopInfo object.

methods.name: NexthopInfo.Equal
methods.description: Checks equality between two NexthopInfo objects.
